fact: On 8 May 2025 the ministry and ATD presented the Digital Ambassadors programme to about 50 ministry secretaries general and cabinet directors, with 80 ambassadors (66 civil servants) to be trained, and presented a 2024 study of public administration digital skills.
title: Présentation du Programme des Ambassadeurs.trices du Digital aux Secrétaires Généraux et Directeurs du Cabinet des Ministères
